title: Pin trusted GitHub Actions provider and strict applied PR rules
summary: The authenticated P00 merge-readiness observer now rejects substituted status-check provider identities even when the ruleset and check match. It additionally requires strict base status checks and PR review-thread resolution. Mock regressions added; production branch protection and operator-host deployment remain unverified.
migration_notes: No released client or data changed. Before any guarded merge, an authorized repository administrator must install the intended ruleset and independently verify effective rules; no auto-merge or worker was enabled.
